title: U.S. House · Michigan's 12th District
area: Western Wayne County, including Dearborn, Dearborn Heights and part of Detroit.

context.text: Incumbent Rashida Tlaib (D) defeated Shanelle Jackson and Byron Nolen in the Democratic primary. James Hooper (R) advanced unopposed from the Republican primary.

candidates.name: Rashida Tlaib

priorities.text: Medicare for All to guarantee healthcare as a right.
priorities.quote: I'll fight for Medicare-for-All that guarantees health care as a right, not a privilege.

priorities.text: A $15 minimum wage and support for labor unions.
priorities.quote: I'll fight for a $15 minimum wage that gives our workers the ability to provide for their families... I'll protect our unions, the organizations that built our middle class.

priorities.text: Ending corporate tax breaks and overturning Citizens United.
priorities.quote: We must stop tax giveaways to rich corporations and developers while our schools are crumbling and people are losing their homes... we must overturn Citizens United to ensure all of our voices are heard.

positions.summary: Campaign site says she co-sponsored the Medicare For All Act.
positions.quote: Co-sponsored the Medicare For All Act and co-led a virtual rally to unveil the legislation.

positions.summary: Campaign site says she introduced the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act, which raises taxes on companies that pay top executives at least 50 times the median worker.
positions.quote: Introduced the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act, which takes on corporate greed by raising taxes on companies that pay their top executives at least 50 times more than the pay of a median worker.

positions.summary: Campaign site says she is advocating to abolish and defund ICE.
positions.quote: She's advocating to abolish and defund ICE

positions.summary: Campaign site says she leads efforts to ensure U.S. tax dollars are not used to fund the Israeli military's human rights abuses and has introduced resolutions to block weapons sales to Israel's government.
positions.quote: Rashida has introduced Joint Resolutions of Disapproval to block weapons sales to Israel's government.

positions.summary: Campaign site says she voted for House bills to protect abortion providers and secure abortion rights, and that she advocates repealing the Hyde Amendment.
positions.quote: Voted for and helped pass bills in the House to ensure reproductive healthcare access across the country, including protecting abortion providers and securing abortion rights

record.text: Assigned to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform and the Committee on Financial Services for the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

Censured by the U.S. House, 234-188, on November 7, 2023, over comments regarding the Israel-Hamas war; the censure resolution said she was censured for 'promoting false narratives regarding the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack on Israel and for calling for the destruction of the state of Israel.' Tlaib responded that criticism of the Israeli government should not be equated with antisemitism.

candidates.researchNotes: No biography gaps beyond birth year, which Ballotpedia and her House biography do not give.

candidates.name: James Hooper

priorities.text: Opposes abortion, describing himself as 'Pro-Life from conception to natural death.'
priorities.quote: I am Pro-Life from conception to natural death. I will be a strong and unwavering voice for LIFE in the U.S. House of Representatives.
I am a strong proponent of the Un-infringeable nature of the Second Amendment. It is the essential bulwark with which all our other rights are guaranteed.

priorities.text: Wants to reduce federal taxation and shrink federal bureaucracy.
priorities.quote: We need taxation policy that focuses on keeping MORE of your hard-earned dollars in your pocket and LESS going to waste in Washington D.C.

positions.summary: States he is pro-life from conception to natural death (campaign website issues page dated July 2022).
positions.quote: I am Pro-Life from conception to natural death.

statements.quote: I am a strong proponent of the Un-infringeable nature of the Second Amendment.
statements.context: On his campaign website issues page (page dated July 2022)

statements.quote: A nation that does not have control of its borders has abrogated its sovereignty.
statements.context: On his campaign website issues page (page dated July 2022)
